question: Which L2 regularization strength and training approach will yield the best cross-validated Brier score?
alternatives: Use specified full-batch GD with 200 iterations exactly as specified
rationale: The task specifies exact fitting conventions (full-batch GD, 200 iterations, learning rate 0.1, weights/bias start at 0, logits clipped [-30,30]) to match a reference implementation. Deviating from these would make results incomparable to the reference fit.
decision: Implement full-batch gradient descent exactly as specified: 200 iterations, lr=0.1, clip logits to [-30,30], update rule w -= 0.1 * (grad_w/n + lambda*w) and b -= 0.1 * (grad_b/n). Search lambda in [0.0, 0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0].
expected_effect: Will produce Brier scores that match the reference implementation exactly, enabling correct identification of best_lambda and improvement_over_baseline
falsifier: If cross-validated Brier scores differ materially from reference (>1e-6 absolute difference on same data/fold split), the implementation deviates from specified conventions
